# BNGA.JK — house coverage rates it BUY

Signal: the South Research division published coverage (v1) with a 12-month target of Rp2,550.0 against Rp1,495.0 (expected total return 79.9%). Why now: the rating crossed the BUY band on the engine's probability-weighted target.

Archetype guess: quality_bank_rerating · method card: per fund record routing for Banks.

- FY2026E ROE of 9.8% is 1.1pp below the 9M2026 actual of 10.9% (F35) and 1.2-2.2pp below the company’s 11.0-12.0% guidance (F54), implying Q4 net profit of about Rp1.29tn against a 9M quarterly average of about Rp1.50tn.
